body:
## Summary
- add a reusable native pointer HID summary fixture for acceptance-gate tests
- assert touch-derived or non-external Android pointer evidence cannot close the physical HID mouse gate
- assert Android-only/no-Host pointer evidence remains blocked even with a physical mouse inventory and Android logs

## Verification
- python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_native_pointer_hid_acceptance
- python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_native_pointer_hid_acceptance scripts.tests.test_peripheral_host_ready_fail_closed
- make native-pointer-hid-gate EVIDENCE_DIR=docs/changes/2026-08-05-phase-1-android-client/evidence/2026-08-31-p0110-native-pointer-hid-current-base-blocked (expected exit 2 / fail-closed)
- git diff --check

This PR does not claim a native pointer runtime pass; it only hardens the verifier tests for blocked/no-Host/touch-derived evidence.
title: Harden native pointer HID fail-closed tests
